answer_1.quote: The task of image captioning is seemingly straightforward to define: use natural language to generate a description that captures the salient content of an image.

answer_2.quote: The CIDEr score of the captions generated by the coherence-aware and the coherence-agnostic models are, respectively, 0.958 and 0.964.

answer_4.quote: We asked our annotators to annotate a subset of randomly selected image-caption pairs generated by this model.
answer_4.guideline: We asked subjects whether the generated captions are "good" or not.
